title: PAT: Accelerating LLM Decoding via Prefix-Aware Attention with Resource Efficient Multi-Tile Kernel
summary_zh: 針對 agent/tool/RAG 工作負載中常見的 shared prefix，PAT 將 decode attention 改寫成 pack-forward-merge：依 prefix group 打包 query，使用 resource-efficient multi-tile kernel，並以 multi-stream forwarding 與 online softmax merge 消除重複 KV 讀取。相較 SOTA attention kernels，平均 attention latency 降低 53.5%，TPOT 降低 17.0–93.1%。
summary_en: For shared-prefix agent/tool/RAG workloads, PAT rewrites decode attention into pack-forward-merge: pack queries by prefix group, select a resource-efficient multi-tile kernel, and use multi-stream forwarding plus online-softmax merge to avoid repeated KV loads. It reduces attention latency by 53.5% on average and TPOT by 17.0–93.1% against state-of-the-art attention kernels.
